reading.title: 3 things to know about the $40 trillion federal debt
reading.summary: The U.S. federal debt hit a record $40 trillion this week. The debt has doubled since 2017, and just paying interest on the accumulated debt now costs the government more than $1 trillion a year.

news.title: Trial of mum accused of killing her three children puts postpartum psychosis on the map
news.summary: Postpartum psychosis is a psychiatric emergency that can involve mania, depression, hallucinations and delusions.
